title: The Globe and Mail spotlights Jeffery Commission on the surge in mining disputes
summary: The Globe and Mail features Burford Director Jeffery Commission on how legal finance is helping mining companies navigate rising investor-state disputes and regulatory risk. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Investor-state and commercial arbitrations in the mining sector are reaching record levels, driven by geopolitical pressures and heightened competition for critical resources. In *The Globe and Mail* ,[Jeffery Commission](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/jeffery-commission/) examines the surge in disputes and outlines how arbitration finance enables mining companies to pursue meritorious claims, mitigate downside risk and monetize awards.


Read the full article[here](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/adv/article-legal-finance-strategies-for-navigating-uptick-in-resource-disputes/) .
